book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Paaceteth
Yesusi Xillo Ayanan kumidi Yordaanoose shaafappe simmida mala Xillo Ayanay iza kaaleththidi bazzo biitta efides.
Heenkka Xala7en oyddu tammu gallas paacettides. He paacettiza gallassatan aykkoka montta gishshas wurseththan gafides.
Xala7eykka Yesusa, «Ne Xoossa naa gidikko ane hayssa shuchchaa kath gidana mala azaza» gides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Asi kaththan xalla deenna geetettidi xaafettides» giidi Xala7es zaarides.
Hessafe kaallidi Xala7ey Yesusa issi dhoqqa zuma bolla kessidi salo gufanththon diza kawoteththata qiphida ayfey xeellanaas bessidi,
«Hayssi ne be7iza biitta kawota godateththinne bonchchoy wurikka taas imettides; tanikka ta dosizaades immanaas dandayza gishshas neeskka immana.
«Hessa gishshas neni kundada taas goynniko hayssi wurikka nees gidana» gides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Ne Godaa Xoossas kundada izas xalla goynna geetettidi xaafettides» gides.

Hessafekka Yesusa Yerusalaamen Xoossa Keeththa xeera kessi essidi Xoossa Maxaafan, «Nena naagana mala Xoossi ne gishshas ba kiitanchcha azazana; ‹Ne tohoy shuchchan dhuphettontta mala kiitanchchati ba kushera nena dhoqqu histti oykkana› geetettidi xaafettida gishshas ane ne Xoossa Naa gidikko hayssafe duge kunda» gides.
Yesusikka, «Ne Godaa Xoossaa paaccofa» geetettides giidi zaarides.
Xala7eykka ba paaccanayssa wursidaappe guye baas injje wodey beettanaashe Yesusappe shaakettides.
Yesusi Galilan Tamaarso Oykkides
Yesusikka Xillo Ayana wolqqan Galila simmides; iza goobateththi Galila achchan diza deretan siyettides.
Izikka Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan tamaarsishin iza timirtey lo7iin asay wurikka iza galatides.
Naazireten Yesusa Ixeteth
Heeppe ba yelettida katama Naazirete yiidi kase Sambata gallas Ayhuda Woosa Keeth geliza mala gelidi Xoossa Maxaafa nababanaas dendi eqqides.
Nabe Isayaasa Maxaafay izas imettiin maxaafaa doyda mala.
Maxaafaakka gordidi Ayhuda Woosa Keeththe naagizayssas zaari immidi uttides. Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan dizayti wurikka iza tishshi histti xeellida.
Izikka isttas, «Hayssi intte intte hayththara siyida maxaafa qaalay hach polettides» gides.
Asay wurikka iza gishshas lo7o xalala haasayeettes; qasseka iza doonappe keziza lo7o qaalaappe dendidayssan malalettidi, «Hayssi Yooseefe naa gidennee?» gida.
Izikka, «Dhale Godoo nerkka nena paththa; Qifirnahoomen neni ooththishin nu siyidayssa hayssan ne katamankka ooththa giza leemiso intte ta bolla malatanayssas sidhey baa» giidi isttas yootides.
Qasseka, «Ta inttes tuma gays; nabey ba yelettida deren bonchchetti erenna.

«Gido attiin ta inttes tuma gays; heedzdzu layththinne bagga gakkanaas saloy gordettiin wolqqama koshay biitta bolla hanida Eelaasa wode he layththatan azinay baynda daro maccassati Isra7eele biittan deettes shin Eelaasi isttafe issineykkoka kiitettibeenna. Gido attiin Sidoona geetettiza biittan Seraphita geetettiza kataman diza issi azinay baynda maccassayko kiitettides.
Nabe Elssa7e wode Isra7eele deren daro inchchirachcha hargizayti deettes; gido attiin Sooriya biitta as Ni7imaaneppe attiin he darotappe oonikka inchchirachcha hargefe paxibeenna» gides.
Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan dizayti wurikka hessa siyidi daro hanqettida.
Ba uttidasohoppe dendi eqqidi Yesusa katamaappe kare kessidi duge zaari yeddanaas istta katamaya oosettida zumaa bolla aafotizason oosettidaso ekki efida.
Gido attiin izi istta giddora shaakki yeggidi aadhdhi bides.
Yesusi Tuna Ayana Kessides
Heeppeka Galila awuraajjan diza Qifirnahoome geetettiza katama wodhdhides; heenkka Sambata gallas daro asa tamaarso oykkides.
Izi Godateththara haasayza gishshas iza timirtezan malalettida.
Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan tuna ayanay oykkida addey dees. Izikka ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi,
«Naazirete Yesusaa ha7i ta waanoo? Nenara tana aazi gaththidee? Ne yiday nuna dhayssanaassee? Ne oonakko ta erays; ne Xoossa Xilloza gidikkii?» giidi waassides.
Yesusikka tuna ayanaza ha addezappe, «Co7u gaada keza» giidi seerides; tuna ayanazikka daro asaa sinththan addeza bollafe yeggidi issi qohokka gaththontta yeddi kezides.
Asay wurikka malalettidi ba giddon issoy issaara, «Aso hayssi ay giza timirtee? Godateththaranne wolqqara iita ayana azazees; isttika kezeettes» giidi haasayettida.
Yesusa goobateththika ubbaso gakkides.
Yesusi Daro Harganchchata Paththides
Hessafe guye Yesusi Ayhuda Woosa Keeththafe kezidi Simoona keeththe gelides. Simoona bolloteya, «Wolqqama misho hargey oykkiin sakettada dishin Yesusa izo paththarkkii!» giidi woossida.
Yesusikka izikko shiiqidi misho hargeza seerides. Misha hargeyka yeddiin heerakka denda eqqada imaththata mokkadus.
Arshey wullana gishin dumma dumma hargey oykkida asaa wursi izakko ekki yida. Izikka hargiza asaa ubbaa bolla ba kushe woththidi paththides.

Tuna ayanati qasseka Yesusa, «Neni Xoossa naa» gishenne waassishe daro asatappe kezida; gido attiin izi istta seerides; tuna ayanati izi Kirstoosa gididayssa eriza gishshas istti issinokka haasayana mala koyibeenna.
Galilan Yesusa Timirte
Gadey wontishin Yesusi issi asikka bayndaso bides. Daro asaykka iza koyishe izi dizaso gakkides. Izi isttafe shaakettidi bontta mala digganaas koyida.
Gido attiin isttas, «Gede hara katama baada Xoossa Kawoteththa Mishiraachcho qaala yootanaas taas bessees; tani kiitettida gita qofay hessa» gides.
Izikka Yuhudan Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan qaala gujji yootides.
